properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js provides pure-JS SHA-1/SHA-2/RIPEMD-160 (top-level hash.js@1.1.7 at lockfile:3258, plus a nested 1.1.3 copy) — dependency of elliptic@6.5.4, shipped with the ethers/web3 stack. The SHA-1 surface it exposes is classically collision-broken, but here it is library surface only: no first-party call site found. Note the app's actual first-party hash use is keccak256 via web3.utils.soliditySha3, reported as a separate new finding.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: bcrypt-pbkdf ^1.0.0 declared in package-lock.json — the bcrypt-based PBKDF used for OpenSSH private-key passphrase encryption; transitive dependency (sshpk/ssh tooling), no direct application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: create-ecdh ^4.0.0 declared in package-lock.json — the classical ECDH key-agreement implementation for the browserified crypto stack (crypto-browserify). Shipped with the build; no application call site found, but reachable through any code path that uses the bundled crypto shim.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: Ed25519 signature capability shipped via transitive dep tweetnacl@0.14.5 (resolved in package-lock.json:6337/12064). Available in the shipped library; no direct call site found in the application — reachable through any dependency that delegates signing to tweetnacl.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.4 (lockfile:2314) is the pure-JS EC crypto core (ECDSA/ECDH over secp256k1 and other curves) required by secp256k1@4.0.2 and the ethers/web3 stack; deps bn.js, brorand, hash.js, hmac-drbg. Available in the shipped library; no first-party ECDSA call site found (the inspector reads storage via providers only), but it is reachable through ethers' signing-key paths. Quantum-deadline class: ECDSA → ML-DSA-65 when the Ethereum ecosystem migrates.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: X25519 key agreement (nacl.scalarMult/box) shipped via transitive dep tweetnacl@0.14.5. Harvest-now-decrypt-later class if used for key agreement; no direct application call site found — capability present in the shipped library.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: scrypt-js 3.0.1 declared in package-lock.json — pure-JS scrypt KDF (memory-hard password hashing), typical of Ethereum keystore (KDF) tooling. Shipped with the build; parameters (N/r/p) live with the caller, not in the lockfile.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: XSalsa20-Poly1305-256 authenticated encryption (nacl.secretbox) shipped via transitive dep tweetnacl@0.14.5 — the AEAD of the shipped crypto stack. No direct application call site found; capability present in the shipped library.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto provider in the shipped dependency tree: tweetnacl@0.14.5 declared in package-lock.json (transitive, ~0.14.0/^0.14.3 required by the web3/ssh tooling stack). Provides XSalsa20-Poly1305 secretbox, Ed25519, X25519, SHA-512, and its own CSPRNG front-end. Available in the shipped library; no call site found in the application.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js@3.0.1 (lockfile:5563) — the scrypt KDF behind ethers' json-wallets module (keystore v3 encryption). Declared in the lockfile, ships in the build; no first-party wallet/keystore call site found in this app, so it is available library surface reachable through ethers' Wallet/keystore paths.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha.js@2.4.11 (lockfile:5657) — pure-JS SHA-1/SHA-224/SHA-256/SHA-384/SHA-512 implementations; dependency of pbkdf2@3.1.2 and the create-hash stack under web3. Ships in the build; no first-party call site found — available library surface. The SHA-1 implementation it carries is classically broken for collisions but nothing here invokes it directly.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.4 (lockfile:2314) — the library entry for the same shipped EC stack described by ALG-710f61f0 (ECDSA via elliptic) and ALG-673c8f24 (secp256k1): the library itself, the algorithm it provides, and the curve it implements are three facets of one dependency. Required by secp256k1@4.0.2; reachable via ethers' signing-key paths; no direct first-party import found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js@1.1.7 top-level (plus nested 1.1.3 copy) — the library entry for the SHA-family surface described by ALG-50e53f84; dependency of elliptic@6.5.4, shipped with the build. No direct first-party import; available library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2@3.1.2 (lockfile:4861) — the library entry for the PBKDF2 surface described by ALG-4de3b020; pure-JS PBKDF2 backed by sha.js/create-hash/create-hmac/ripemd160, pulled by web3@1.3.5's account stack. No first-party call site; available in the shipped library.
